summary_1line: After King Dasaratha’s death, the queens and citizens of Ayodhya lament deeply while Kaushalya condemns Kaikeyi and ministers preserve the king’s body until Rama returns.

image_candidates.scene_text: Queen Kaushalya sits on the ground holding the lifeless head of King Dasaratha in her lap while the palace women wail around her.
Ministers solemnly lower King Dasaratha’s body into a large oil-filled vessel as the queens raise their arms and cry in grief.
The city of Ayodhya appears dark and silent like a moonless night, its streets filled with weeping men and women.
